data.description: Water orms are rarely discovered except by their own choice.  As a full-round action while in water, a water orm can move up to its run speed (200 ft.) without leaving any trace of its passage (identical in effect to pass without trace).  An elusive water orm gains a +40 circumstance bonus to its Stealth check.  In addition, when not in combat, a water orm is considered to be under the effects of a nondetection spell.  These effects function at caster level 20th and cannot be dispelled.
